John, saw Bitsight topped the Forrester Wave for Cybersecurity Risk Ratings and was named a Visionary in the 2026 Gartner MQ for Cyber Threat Intelligence.

I built a personalized signal play for Bitsight off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

John, quick follow-up for Bitsight.

As a CRO, you know analyst recognition spikes demand faster than headcount can absorb. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Bitsight needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
John, last bit of proof for Bitsight.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Bitsight's reply rate likely compares to other security software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
